routes.meaning: Inspect state/status; prepare expiring source-free intent authorization; explicit authorized StartFresh. No automatic state creation.
Body family/version explicitly selects governed resultId; canonical owned gh1 result only, never lexical legacy conversion.
Clear governed projections by authoritative state transition, not enumeration snapshot.

compatibility.legacyV1: Unchanged exact routes/body/response. Never route by ID prefix. Reject unsupported explicit versions before SDK writes. No progress/reset/export scope added.
compatibility.governedReads: Existing governed item/read wire unchanged in this draft; readers and all receipt-summary replay producers MUST gain internal state fences before mutation activation. Coordinated Android client must inspect state before cache reuse and tag/drop stale asynchronous responses. No old-client invalidation success claimed.

identity.source: validated unexpired Cognito access-token subject only
identity.device: current active pointer version/fingerprint and owned ACTIVE binding
identity.account: ACTIVE adult profile, deletion ledger absent, verified complete retained HMAC key inventory
identity.atomicFences: Exact current inventory/profile/deletion/pointer/binding/control/receipt/operation intent snapshot as applicable; acknowledged strong reads, one no-auto-retry SDK write attempt.

stateIdentity.incarnation: fresh random128-bit lowercase hex; never reused on fresh state or restore
stateIdentity.generation: nonnegative monotonic integer per account/incarnation; no wrap or client-time ordering
stateIdentity.missing: UNAVAILABLE; never infer original generation0, lawful expiry or erasure success
stateIdentity.expiry: Expired state cannot authorize ordinary read/admission/delete/clear. It may only be replaced by explicitly approved StartFresh after exact supported expired-state/identity/inventory checks. Retirement needs original deadline/job proof; missing never inferred generation0. Valid live control cannot be StartFresh-replaced.
stateIdentity.restore: Externally authoritative restore epoch outside restored resources; gates closed, old handlers drained, all old incarnations/proofs/cursors/caches/summary replay invalidated before any reopening.
stateIdentity.capture: Restore incarnation + account incarnation + generation + controlKeyId, never only an integer.

admit: Read current live control, current auth fences and funding separately.

Transaction captures exact incarnation+generation on authoritative check receipt, conditions same control version, and extends bounded control hold for NEW admission only. Existing quota/accounting reservation transaction remains atomic.
settle: Use admitted cryptographic proof/execution owner and settle accounting at most once.

Transaction conditions SAME captured current control used to decide projection. Current incarnation/generation may write governedHistory AND resultSummary; stale/missing state writes neither copy, records only fixed disposition, preserving accounting/outcome/expiry.
On clear/control race reread and select suppression branch with bounded CAS retry; never rerun evaluator/provider or reserve/charge twice. Duplicate SETTLED never reconstructs assessment.
deleteOne: Resolve owned canonical settled result and both five-field copies; bind exact result identity/proof/accounting and current control/auth.

ONE transaction removes the five assessment/index fields, sets fixed ERASED disposition on existing receipt, and conditionally creates owner-scoped operation receipt. No upsert, accounting/proof/TTL/operations changes.
clear: ONE transaction CAS increments current History generation, creates immutable owner/intent-bound operation receipt and purge job covering prior state. An expired lease may not execute; check final deadline before enqueue.
All governed reads AND core reconcile/consumer/worker cached summary replay filter current control immediately; asynchronous physical purge is separate <=24h obligation.
Both settlement-before-clear and clear-before-settlement leave old History excluded and accounting unchanged. New-generation admissions remain eligible.

Purge uses bounded strongly consistent canonical owner-partition CHECK-range traversal across complete retained-key inventory. GSI empty pages are not absence evidence. Each removal checks captured old state/result identity and never removes current-generation admissions; unfinished/unknown records keep completion unqualified.
startFresh: Only separately approved explicit customer StartFresh with a fresh server-issued lease, for ABSENT control or an exact supported control whose hold has logically expired. Valid live control, malformed/duplicate state and unqualified restore-incompatible state are refused; ordinary live invalidation uses clear.
ONE transaction checks current ABSENT or exact expected state, current identity/inventory/deletion, creates NEW random incarnation with generation0 and original op receipt/purge job.
Suppress/purge ALL other or missing incarnations including restored old rows and proofs; do not rewrite them into current generation. Accounting dedup/charged usage remains independent.
read: Canonical receipt+control must be read atomically or by equivalent verified snapshot/final fence; stale GSI/cursor is discovery only.

Every public summary path filters ERASED, wrong/missing/expired incarnation/generation and original expiry. A response already linearized/in flight cannot be recalled; Android drops responses tagged before known invalidation.
Before showing caches on reconnect, inspect current state. Offline devices cannot promise immediate remote erasure.

operations.key: owner-HMAC partition plus operation UUID and explicit governed family; never client owner selector
operations.intent: version/family/action/target-result binding/original expected state + server-issued UUID/lease binding; purpose-separated intent HMAC, no submitted content
operations.firstCommit: Conditional receipt absence and all state/target fences in SAME transaction as effects; response immutable original commit time/state.
operations.sameOperationWithinWindow: Exact original intent returns original immutable committed result; changed intent conflicts. Current auth/owner/deletion still required.
operations.afterWindow: No lifetime UUID registry. Original expired intentLease cannot execute even if state/receipt missing; identical old clear also has stale expected state. New intentional operation requires explicit prepare, NEW server-issued UUID/nonce and current state. No reissued old UUID under fresh lease.
operations.unknownCommit: Strong read exact owner/UUID/family receipt and intent. Exact receipt proves logical commit only; unreadable/absent/unacknowledged is UNRESOLVED, not success or fresh-ID retry. A later same-intent transaction can only win conditional receipt absence; original expected state prevents re-clear.
operations.response: schemaVersion2/family/operationId/action/commitTime/committedHistoryState/invalidationStatus=COMMITTED/purgeStatusAtCommit=PENDING|COMPLETE/purgeDueAtEpoch. It never calls physical cleanup COMPLETE merely because invalidation committed. Inspect returns separately timestamped current purge status; original retry response does not change.

intentLease.issuedBy: Existing bootstrap route explicit schema2 prepare; server generates NEW UUIDv4 operationId and fresh nonce, client cannot choose/reissue old operationId.
signedBindings: original expected incarnation/generation or explicit ABSENT
authenticated owner/device pointer version/fingerprint and inventory revision via purpose-separated MAC
intentLease.checks: At dispatch freshly reauthorize, verify MAC/bindings/fixed original expiry and exact expected state. No authz from a supplied lease alone.
intentLease.expired: May verify old MAC solely to read exact committed same-intent receipt within its7day window. Missing/expired receipt or expired lease without committed evidence means CONFLICT/UNRESOLVED, never new execution.
intentLease.lostIssueResponse: No mutation has occurred. A new explicit prepare generates a different logical operation; never run both responses. No server issue-side accounting/content write.
intentLease.keyRotation: Retained original signing/intent key version must remain verified/available through the live7day operation-receipt window, not only the600second execution lease. Unavailable key means unresolved/refused; never re-sign/reissue oldUUID or reconstruct success. Key retirement/restore requires separately qualified inventory; no automatic key-retention permission.

operations.responseSchemaVersion: Existing response types are not silently reused; full V2 response field contract specified here is a draft and must be shipped with coordinated Android strict decoder before activation.

erasedReplay: Within original accounting receipt lifetime return existing versioned envelope with accounting but no outcome and current generic unavailable mapping; do not invent current public erased code. Mutation response explicitly differentiates committed invalidation from purge; future consumer UI refinement requires its own versioned schema before adding new public codes.
generationDomains: History generation does not reset recognition; recognition reset does not clear History. No points/quota/cash/campaign effects or historical backfill.
cutover: Fail closed until every serving writer/read/reconcile/summary/cache path is covered. Existing rows without capture are unqualified; no inferred generation0/backfill. Drain original windows or separately reviewed explicit StartFresh/migration under closed gates.

controlLocation.stateKey: Existing authority table owned V1#<retainedKeyId>#<accountHMAC> / GOVERNED#STATE
controlLocation.operationKey: Same selected control partition / GOVERNED#MUTATION#<serverUUID>; purge job GOVERNED#ERASURE#<serverUUID>
controlLocation.resolver: Acknowledged strong GetItem exact state key under EVERY retained HMAC key in verified inventory. Exactly one supported canonical state allowed; duplicates/malformed/unknown fail closed. Missing is not current generation0.
controlLocation.keyRotation: Keep existing control at its original retained controlKeyId until qualified retirement. New admissions may use active check key but MUST capture/reference SAME canonical controlKeyId/incarnation/generation. No second state silently created on active-key rotation; no move/redirect record introduced.
controlLocation.creation: Explicit approved StartFresh requires exact prior-state CAS or state-absence conditions under ALL retained keys, plus exact inventory revision/keyset, in SAME transaction as one new state/op receipt/job.
controlLocation.bounds: Candidate requires <=16 retained control key versions and <=100 transaction actions, <=4MiB payload and <=4KiB each condition; exceeding a bound refuses activation/operation, never splits safety fence or truncates inventory. No actual inventory cardinality claimed.
controlLocation.retirement: Control key remains verified/available for current state hold, operation receipts and qualified purge/account deletion. Key removal cannot strand owned data; no automatic retirement or extended-key authorization.

purgeWorker.scope: Trusted lifecycle worker consumes only immutable job originally committed with current customer authorization; no public account-targeted event or new owner locator. Job stores owned HMAC partition/inventory binding, not raw subject.
purgeWorker.continuity: Device move/session expiry/subscription loss cannot cancel already committed erasure. Background purge does not require original device to remain active or create new grants/identity. Global account deletion independently derives all retained owned partitions and removes controls/jobs through existing authority inventory.
purgeWorker.atomicRemoval: Each candidate removal requires exact existing canonical receipt/job/verified inventory and exact observed CURRENT control to prove result is logically excluded. Protect actual current incarnation/generation, including incarnations created after an older StartFresh job; never compare random incarnation strings for ordering.
purgeWorker.laterControlChange: A control race cancels the CAS and rereads. An earlier purge may remove an assessment subsequently invalidated by a newer explicit clear, but never a currently valid assessment. Completion uses bounded complete canonical traversal plus unchanged scope/control fence, not empty GSI.
purgeWorker.noResurrection: Only conditional REMOVE/update-existing/delete actions. Never recreate missing receipt, control, job or operation receipt after account cleanup or operation TTL. Missing/malformed commit evidence stays unresolved unless exact acknowledged absence/completion contract establishes that bounded scope; no new receipt is fabricated.
